# edgeinfer

Toolkit and experiments for taking PyTorch semantic-segmentation models (SegFormer-B0 and a CNN, Cityscapes) to TensorRT under real-time latency, accuracy and memory budgets, with tooling to prove the optimized model is still correct.

Work in progress. See `docs/roadmap.md` for the plan and `docs/progress.md` for current status.
